prerequisites.title: Paid Help Scout plan
prerequisites.detail: The Free plan has no API access, and each paid plan has different API levels. Standard has no reporting endpoints, while Plus and Pro have all endpoints.

prerequisites.title: Active invited user in the account
prerequisites.detail: Credentials must belong to an active, invited Help Scout user, or the API returns a 401 error.

prerequisites.title: Your own OAuth app credentials
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Help Scout app, so you register your own and supply the client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create the OAuth2 app in Help Scout
steps.detail: Go to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App. Enter your redirect URL; for Client Credentials only, a placeholder URL works.
inputs: Help Scout login on a paid plan
Redirect URI from the Composio dashboard
steps.done_when: You have an application ID and application secret.

steps.title: Get the Composio redirect URI
steps.detail: Copy the callback URI from the Composio dashboard, or have the agent fetch it, before creating the Help Scout app. Check it is an HTTPS URL.
steps.done_when: The redirect URI is ready to paste into Help Scout.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create an auth config for the help_scout toolkit through Composio's API using your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

steps.title: Test authorization with a real account
steps.detail: Connect a Help Scout account. The user logs in if needed, then approves on Help Scout's authorization screen.
steps.done_when: A connected account is created in Composio.

steps.title: Check brand guidelines before public launch
steps.detail: Read Help Scout's brand guidelines, and tell Help Scout when the project is finished.

traps.title: No managed app, even for prototypes
traps.detail: Composio does not provide a managed Help Scout app. You need your own credentials from the start.

traps.title: Plan limits on customers' accounts
traps.detail: API access depends on the plan, and rate limits are up to 200, 400 or 800 calls per minute on Standard, Plus and Pro. The Free plan has no API access.

traps.title: Client Credentials is for internal use
traps.detail: Use the Authorization Code flow for integrations that other Help Scout users will use.
